claims.claim: Invoices in the billing source record the billed name as Northbridge Analytics Inc.
MSA-NBA-2021 names its counterparty as Northbridge Analytics, Inc.
Billing and the MSA both use the name Northbridge Analytics Inc., while sales uses the short name Northbridge Analytics.
A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named Northbridge Analytics LLC associated with the Northbridge name family.
Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party for the MSA.
The registry link between the billing referent and the MSA counterparty is to be treated as unresolved.
billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and the counterparty named in contract:MSA-NBA-2021 denote the same legal counterparty.
billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 denote distinct legal counterparties.

support_claim: The packet explicitly preserves the registry link as unresolved and states that legal has not determined which registry entity is the MSA contracting party, so neither same-entity identity nor distinctness is established.
